== Course of events ==

After the companions gathered in the Throne Room and agreed to set out together the next morning, the Scarecrow was made ruler of the Emerald City. The people of the Emerald City took pride in being governed by a stuffed man, accepting him as their leader over the place he now presided over.

With the Scarecrow established as ruler, he went on to decide that Dorothy must travel south to Glinda's castle, despite warnings of wild beasts and hostile Quadlings along the road, showing him already exercising his new authority over the group's course.
